# Third-party code in this folder

These files are unmodified copies of published npm packages, included so the site needs no external CDN.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| firebase-app-compat.js, firebase-auth-compat.js, firebase-firestore-compat.js | firebase (Firebase JS SDK, Google) | 12.19.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| jspdf.umd.min.js | jspdf | 4.2.1 | MIT |
| jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js | jspdf-autotable | 5.0.9 | MIT |

Each package's full licence text is in its npm tarball (`LICENSE`) and repository.

| ../fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2 | JetBrains Mono, The JetBrains Mono Project Authors |
